title: Product Bundle Recapture on GAP Waiver Cancellation
content:
# Product Bundle Recapture on GAP Waiver Cancellation

F&I bundle pricing terms, Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda. When the holder cancels a Kessler GAP waiver, an amount is recaptured from the cancellation refund according to the status of the companion products sold on the same Vehicle Purchase Agreement as the waiver:

- where a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contract sold on the same purchase deal is in active status, 50.00 is recaptured from the cancellation refund;
- where no such contract is active and a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plan sold on the same purchase deal is in active status, 25.00 is recaptured;
- in every other case nothing is recaptured.

The recapture is deducted from the refund after the unused-share amount has been rounded half up to the cent. The status read is the one the service contract's and the maintenance plan's own records show at the time the refund is computed.

Products read: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts and Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans, by the status on each product's own record.

## Truth table

| Kessler Shield contract on the deal, active | Kessler Care plan on the deal, active | Recapture |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 50.00 |
| Yes | No | 50.00 |
| No | Yes | 25.00 |
| No | No | Nothing |

"No" includes a product that was never sold on the deal and one sold on the deal that is cancelled, expired or (for a plan) fulfilled. A product bought on its own, outside the purchase deal that carries the waiver, is not read.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A waiver was sold on a deal that also carried a Kessler Shield contract, since cancelled, and a Kessler Care plan that is still active: the contract is not active, the plan is, so 25.00 is recaptured.
